name: Von ven soup
summary: Soup of lá vón vén and scorched buffalo tail, served after a long round of wine. The broth is plain, lightly sour, and sweet.
taste: Báo Sơn La says lightly sour and sweet in the broth.
howToEat: As the soup, with the meal.
seoTitle: Canh von ven in Son La — leaf soup with buffalo tail
seoDescription: Canh lá vón vén in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La simmers scorched buffalo tail and calls the broth lightly sour and sweet.
